segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: OK, are you all settled?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Well, first of all, welcome to Cardiff University.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: I'm here to explain what we can offer you.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Now, as a new student at the university, you will probably need some sort of guidance to help you to use the library effectively to study and research.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Some of you have asked about a guided tour but we find this rather muddles people.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: So, in this first week. we run a series of talks which focus on different aspects of the library and its resources.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: You'll also find that to get the most out of the library you really do need to be computer literate and so all this term we run small classes which will bring you up to speed on how to access the computer-loaded information.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: OK, now let me give you an outline of what's available to you.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: You'll find that the computers are increasingly used as a research tool.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Many students do most of their research on the internet and the library computers are permanently online.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Having found what you need, you'll find you can readily save texts on your personal computer space to print ofT when you need.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: You might think that it is the fastest way to get information but the links can be slow.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Clearly you can find lots on there but much of it is useless information as it is from highly debatable sources- so be critical.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: You'll also find that the library has loaded several CD-ROMS onto the computers from specialist reference sources such as the MLA.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It means we can expand what we offer you at very little extra cost and saves us having to invest in more and more books.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The CD-ROMS contain exactly the same information as the reference books as the two are updated together.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Now most of you will need to refer to journal articles in your work and you'll find you can also access these online and we encourage you to do so.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Clearly some of you will find the printed version more accessible as it sits on the shelves but 'm afraid the intention is to phase these out eventually.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: However, you will still be able to print ofT a version of the text rather than photocopying the journal pages.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: So you must get used to working online.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Naturally we do still have the full range of classic reference books, additional to the CD-ROMS, for you to use and there are several copies of each one.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: This is because some of you may prefer to borrow a book rather than sit in the library.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There is a restricted loan time on these so that they are not missing from the shelves for too long.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Although there is a Section Manager for each part of the library, they are very busy and so, if you do get stuck looking for things, you should ask the relevant Cataloguing Assistant.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: As your Training Supervisor, I just oversee your induction and will not be around after this initial week.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Some of you may be interested to know that the library is offering specialised training sessions on writing a dissertation.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Obviously this is not relevant to those of you who are undergraduates; it is just for postgraduates.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Your department will discuss the planning stage of the dissertation- i.e. what you're going to do- with you and we will focus on the structure of it.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: However, the training will also include some time on the computers. realise most of you know how to organise files but we can show you the different ways to run data programmes.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Your tutors will tell you at the outset how to set out the chapters they require but you will need to ask them how they would like you to organise the bibliography because it varies depending on your subject area.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: When you've got something together the trainer here will look through the draft version for you to see if it's OK.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: And, one final point, for those of you who have registered from abroad, we can offer individual sessions on dissertations if you feel you need them. llYm! require language lessons then they are available from the International Centre next to the Law Department.

S ECTION 4 Questions 31-40
Questions 31-36
Choose the correct letter. A, B or C.
31 During the first week of term, students are invited to
A be shown round the library by the librarian.
B listen to descriptions of library resources.
C do an intensive course in the computer centre.
32 The speaker warns the students that
A internet materials can be unreliable.
B downloaded information must be acknowledged.
C computer access may be limited at times.
33 The library is acquiring more COs as a resource because
A they are a cheap source of information.
B they take up very little space.
C they are more up to date than the reference books.
34 Students are encouraged to use journals online because
A the articles do not need to be returned to the shelves.
B reading online is cheaper than photocopying articles.
C the stock of printed articles is to be reduced.
35 Why might some students continue to use reference books?
A they can be taken away from the library
B they provide information unavailable elsewhere
C they can be borrowed for an extended loan period
36 What is the responsibility of the Training Supervisor?
. A to supervise and support library staff
B to provide orientation to the library facilities
C to identify needs and inform section managers
Questions 37-40
Which section of the university will help postgraduate students with their dissertations in the
following ways?
A the postgraduate's own department or tutor
8 library staff
C another section of the university
Write the correct letter. A, B or C. next to questions 37-40.
37 training in specialised computer programs
38 advising on bibliography presentation
39 checking the draft of the dissertation
40 providing language support
